source.path: Wolfe et al. /Wolfe et al experimental data.csv

discovery: A single source label 6HoLM1 conflicts with other 6HoLM treatment-code replicates, discovered from metadata before v1.211 outcome scoring.
strategy: DROP 6HoLM1 entirely, not re-label it, and regard its intended experimental arm's observation as unassigned; for 45 planned cells × 4 units, the 175 remaining records leave 5 unknown outcomes.
scoring_definition: Same 18-stratum 4/6-patch heterogeneous minus homogeneous day-21 joint generalist and specialist microcosm outcome as v1.210 and v1.211. Do not change guild definitions, presence threshold or equal stratum weights.
planned_design_assumption: Original 45 factorial cells have exactly four planned experimental units each. No assertion about which treatment the excluded row actually received.
summaries_to_report: sharp binary missing-outcome lower and upper bounds in every stratum (planned denominator=4)
bounds and observed contrasts separately for 4 and 6 patches
interaction contrast lower/upper from worst-case separate patch-count bounds
same for generalist and specialist separately as secondary only
missing_outcome_interpretation: Finite-sample extreme-case bounds, not 95% confidence intervals; no inferential p-values, significance or conservation causal claims.
source_response_semantics: Already published day-21 experiment, not measured colonization, demographic rescue, co-occurrence in same local patch or a new island mammal dispersal validation.
